metadata.title: Ricci entropy, RCD structures and Kahler spaces
metadata.abstract: This paper is the final installment in our series on the geometric theory of complex Monge-Ampere equations. We study singular Kahler metrics on compact normal Kahler spaces with klt singularities whose volume densities lie in $L^p$ for some $p>1$. We show that a lower bound for the Ricci current in the sense of pluripotential theory is equivalent to a synthetic Ricci lower bound in the sense of RCD theory. As a consequence, every Kahler class on a compact normal Kahler space with klt singularities admits an RCD structure, which makes differential geometric analysis available on singular complex spaces. As an application, we show that the fundamental group of a compact Kahler Calabi-Yau space with klt singularities is almost Abelian. We further establish compactness results for singular Kahler-Einstein spaces.

analysis.topic: 度量测度几何、极限与奇异空间
analysis.progressType: 奇异 Kähler 空间的 Ricci 与 RCD 等价
analysis.workSummary: 对紧正规 klt Kähler 空间上具有有界局部势、适配体积密度 Lᵖ 控制并在正则部光滑正定的 current，证明 Ric≥−ω 的完备化为非塌缩 RCD(−1,2n) 空间，并识别其与原复空间同胚。
analysis.breakthrough: 把奇异复空间纳入合成 Ricci 分析，推出 klt Kähler Calabi–Yau 空间基本群几乎交换。
analysis.limitations: 主定理要求正则部光滑 Kähler 度量及指定势和密度条件；Ricci 另有上界时，奇集维数界由 2n−3 改进至 2n−4。
analysis.aiEvidence: 作者明确将关键技术命题 5.1 的证明归于 ChatGPT-6 Astra。

aiReview.note: 对该版本全部可提取页面做 AI 披露关键词检索，并核对命中段落；这不是对整篇数学证明的审读。作者明确将关键技术命题 5.1 的证明归于 ChatGPT-6 Astra。
